captions.detailed: A ladder-frame two-branch fixture consisting of a black vertical ladder-like support structure mounted on a square black base. Two gray U-shaped cheek blocks are attached at different heights and lateral offsets on the frame. Each cheek block houses an orange stub arm that rotates independently on a black cylindrical pin, forming two separate revolute joints. The lower orange arm is longer than the upper orange arm to maintain a clear visual silhouette.
captions.instruction: Generate a ladder-frame two-branch fixture with a vertical black ladder support mounted on a square base. It should feature two offset gray cheek blocks at different heights, each holding an orange stub arm that rotates on a black pin as an independent revolute joint, with the lower arm being longer than the upper one.
captions.factory: Construct a base and ladder frame using Box primitives. Create two gray cheek blocks by subtracting smaller boxes from larger ones to form U-shapes, then place them at different heights and lateral positions. Create two orange arms using box shapes with rounded cylindrical ends, and attach them to the cheek blocks via cylindrical pins. Define revolute joints for each arm rotating around the Y-axis of their respective pin locations.
